title: Matrix Public Data Laboratory
boundary: The laboratory lets readers reproduce counts, filters, joins and aggregations over approved public datasets. Query output reflects the selected records and code; it does not prove causation, motive, coordination, identity, present ownership or wrongdoing. Machine-extracted and machine-classified records remain subject to their stated review status and source limitations.

datasets.title: Entity Registry
datasets.description: Structured people, companies, agencies, contracts, cases, findings and other entities with review status and evidence counts.
datasets.boundary: An entity record establishes that the named item appears in the structured registry. It does not establish guilt, ownership, control, identity equivalence or a substantive relationship beyond cited evidence.
datasets.defaultSql: SELECT type, COUNT(*) AS records, SUM(TRY_CAST(evidence_count AS BIGINT)) AS evidence_references FROM entities GROUP BY type ORDER BY records DESC

datasets.title: Relationship Registry
datasets.description: Evidence-linked relationships, mentions, filing subjects, source changes and other documented edges.
datasets.boundary: A relationship row records what a cited source states or what a parser observed. Mention, proximity and association do not establish control, coordination, payment, intent or wrongdoing.
datasets.defaultSql: SELECT type, evidence_grade, COUNT(*) AS records FROM relationships GROUP BY type, evidence_grade ORDER BY records DESC

datasets.title: SEC Market Activity
datasets.description: Official Form 4 transactions and Form 13F position changes collected from SEC EDGAR.
datasets.boundary: SEC filings report transactions or quarter-end positions under specific disclosure rules. They do not establish motive, investment merit, current ownership, coordination or wrongdoing; 13F changes do not reveal exact trade dates or execution prices.
datasets.defaultSql: SELECT issuer, action, COUNT(*) AS records, SUM(TRY_CAST(reportedValue AS DOUBLE)) AS reported_value FROM market_activity GROUP BY issuer, action ORDER BY reported_value DESC NULLS LAST

datasets.title: Evidence Network Export
datasets.description: Public network-map export connecting evidence-led nodes and edges used by the visual investigation map.
datasets.boundary: Network position and connectivity describe the exported graph. Centrality, density and proximity do not establish hierarchy, command, conspiracy, motive or unlawful conduct.

presets.title: Entities by type
presets.description: Count registry records and attached evidence references by entity type.
presets.sql: SELECT type, COUNT(*) AS records, SUM(TRY_CAST(evidence_count AS BIGINT)) AS evidence_references FROM entities GROUP BY type ORDER BY records DESC

presets.title: Highest evidence-count entities
presets.description: Surface records with the largest number of attached evidence references without treating volume as proof.
presets.sql: SELECT name, type, review_status, TRY_CAST(evidence_count AS BIGINT) AS evidence_count, first_seen, last_seen FROM entities ORDER BY evidence_count DESC NULLS LAST, name

presets.title: Relationship types and grades
presets.description: Compare relationship categories by evidence grade and review status.
presets.sql: SELECT type, evidence_grade, review_status, COUNT(*) AS records FROM relationships GROUP BY type, evidence_grade, review_status ORDER BY records DESC

presets.title: Most represented relationship sources
presets.description: Count relationship records by public source while retaining grade and status distinctions.
presets.sql: SELECT source_title, evidence_grade, COUNT(*) AS records FROM relationships GROUP BY source_title, evidence_grade ORDER BY records DESC

presets.title: Relationship edges with entity names
presets.description: Join relationship endpoints to the entity registry for reproducible edge inspection.
presets.sql: SELECT r.type, COALESCE(a.name, r."from") AS from_name, COALESCE(b.name, r."to") AS to_name, r.evidence_grade, r.factual_status, r.source_title, r.source_url, r.does_not_establish FROM relationships r LEFT JOIN entities a ON a.id = r."from" LEFT JOIN entities b ON b.id = r."to" ORDER BY r.retrieval_date DESC NULLS LAST

presets.title: Market disclosures by issuer and action
presets.description: Aggregate reported SEC records by issuer and action category.
presets.sql: SELECT issuer, ticker, action, COUNT(*) AS records, SUM(TRY_CAST(shares AS DOUBLE)) AS reported_shares, SUM(TRY_CAST(reportedValue AS DOUBLE)) AS reported_value FROM market_activity GROUP BY issuer, ticker, action ORDER BY reported_value DESC NULLS LAST

presets.title: Largest reported market values
presets.description: Inspect the largest values reported in the source export with filing links attached.
presets.sql: SELECT recordType, subject, issuer, ticker, action, transactionDate, periodEnd, filingDate, TRY_CAST(shares AS DOUBLE) AS shares, TRY_CAST(reportedValue AS DOUBLE) AS reported_value, factualStatus, sourceUrl FROM market_activity WHERE TRY_CAST(reportedValue AS DOUBLE) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY reported_value DESC

presets.title: Market records by month
presets.description: Group Form 4 and 13F-derived records by the available transaction or period date.
presets.sql: SELECT SUBSTR(COALESCE(NULLIF(transactionDate, ''), NULLIF(periodEnd, ''), filingDate), 1, 7) AS month, recordType, action, COUNT(*) AS records, SUM(TRY_CAST(reportedValue AS DOUBLE)) AS reported_value FROM market_activity GROUP BY month, recordType, action ORDER BY month DESC, records DESC

presets.title: Evidence network rows
presets.description: Open the public network-map export for filtering and schema inspection.
